description: This PHP source file defines the class ProjectViewTemplatesDetail, which extends the ViewDetail class. It manages the display logic for the detailed view of 'Project Templates' within the SuiteCRM application, including rendering the module title, user permissions, and subpanels.

classes.name: ProjectViewTemplatesDetail
classes.description: A specialized view class for displaying details of project templates in SuiteCRM, handling module title setup, permissions-based display logic, and subpanel rendering.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Constructs the parameters for the module title, including a link to edit the current project.

parameters.name: $browserTitle
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the title is for the browser.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the main display logic for the view, including loading the project bean, assigning template variables based on user permissions, and calling parent display method.

methods.name: _displaySubPanels
methods.description: Renders the subpanels related to the project template by including the SubPanelTiles class and displaying the subpanel content.
